candy coated killahz.bio: Toronto group Candy Coated Killahz blended hip-hop, R&B and electronic music into the self-described 'ghettotronic' sound that made them a fixture of the city's late-2000s Queen West scene.

casey mq.bio: Hamilton-born Canadian musician Casey MQ is a singer, songwriter, producer and film composer whose electronic pop work moves between intimate songwriting and experimental club music.

casper skulls.bio: Sudbury- and Toronto-rooted indie-rock band Casper Skulls blends post-punk, dream-pop and alternative rock with collaborative songwriting and a tightly wound live sound.

cat clyde.bio: Ontario singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Cat Clyde draws on blues, folk, soul and roots traditions for a warm, contemporary sound shaped by classic songwriting forms.

charlotte cardin.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Charlotte Cardin blends pop, electro, soul and R&B with bilingual songwriting, understated production and a distinctive low-register vocal style.

charmaine.bio: Zimbabwean-Canadian rapper Charmaine is a Toronto-based artist known for assertive, high-energy hip-hop and the Juno-winning single Bold.

chiiild.bio: Montréal project Chiiild, led by producer and songwriter Yonatan Ayal, blends R&B, psychedelic soul, indie rock and electronic production into a sound the group calls synthetic soul.

chokeules.bio: London, Ontario-born Toronto rapper Chokeules is a veteran of Canada's underground hip-hop scene whose work includes solo releases and membership in Swamp Thing and the Backburner crew.

cleopatrick.bio: Cobourg, Ontario rock duo cleopatrick makes stripped-down, heavy alternative rock built around guitar, drums and a DIY approach the band describes as laptop rock.

coleman hell.bio: Thunder Bay-born Canadian musician Coleman Hell blends pop, electronic and folk influences and broke through internationally with the 2015 single 2 Heads.

command sisters.bio: Alberta-born, Toronto-based sibling duo Command Sisters pairs Charlotte Command's vocals and keys with Sarah Command's guitar in polished pop songwriting built around the sisters' close creative partnership.
